annotation.bound_parties_text: The Order binds persons who operate small unmanned aircraft (remote pilots), responsible persons of registered unmanned aircraft, and registered remote pilots (who must update information), and it empowers the Director-General of Civil Aviation and authorized officers.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Subdivision 2 requires responsible persons and registered remote pilots to update documents and information
annotation.dates_quote: Subject to subsection (2), this Order comes into operation on 1 June 2022.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Sections 2 to 6 define expressions used in the Order (including small unmanned aircraft, operate, flight and enclosed area).
